THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
RUNWAY
075
STUDY 046
Gray Fur Vest & Leather Mini
Rights check
Source: 24388.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, sleek, light blonde
hair walks a runway with a slight wind lift. She wears a
plush gray faux-fur vest with studded edges over a
fitted black knit top, and a black leather mini skirt with
white piping. Sheer black tights and black heels
complete the look. Her expression is calm and direct. A
dark wooden wall behind her, a purple carpet runway,
and warm stage light. Palette of gray, black, and violet.
Edgy and glamorous, in the style of a winter runway
editorial.
Edgy, glamorous, bold
WORKING NOTES
- The plush fur vest and studded edges define the look.
- Add 'mid-stride' for a walking runway shot.
